## Checklist

- [ ] `./mvnw verify` passes locally, with Docker running
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] A schema change is a new Liquibase changeset, a released one is not edited
- [ ] README or CONTRIBUTING is updated if the change is visible to users or contributors
- [ ] No secrets or machine-specific settings are committed
